title: Comet Guard
description: Defend a luminous orbital station in a painted starfield. Fly an interceptor, shatter molten comets and survive escalating waves.
controls: WASD / arrows move · mouse aim + hold click fire · Space auto-aim + fire · touch drag to fly + auto-fire · P / Esc pause · R restart

zh-CN.title: 彗星守卫
zh-CN.description: 守护星空中发光的轨道空间站。驾驶拦截机击碎熔岩彗星，撑过一波比一波猛的攻势。
zh-CN.controls: WASD / 方向键移动 · 鼠标瞄准、按住左键开火 · 空格自动瞄准开火 · 触屏拖动飞行并自动开火 · P / Esc 暂停 · R 重开
